name: First Bite
source:
ONE NIGHT. THREE VAMPIRES.
MAKE A DEAL WITH DEATH OR DIE TRYING.

What would you do if you had the chance at a second life, after death? 

Put your destiny in the hands of three centuries-old vampires in this LGBTQ+ dark comedy visual novel. This project explores the thing that both humans and creatures of the night have in common: The desire to survive. 

Play as Noe, a human and lover of all things paranormal, as they take a chance and enter the strange house on Dead End Drive with the hope that the rumors they’ve heard about its inhabitants are true. There they find Laurel, Ilyas, and Valeria, and they quickly discover that there’s no escape, but not all endings are fatal.

[Edited from [url=https://www.firstbitegames.com/about]official website[/url]]
translation:
一夜。三名吸血鬼。
与死亡达成交易，或死在尝试的路上。

如果死后还能获得第二次生命，你会怎么做？

在这部LGBTQ+黑色喜剧视觉小说中，将命运交到三位活了数百年的吸血鬼手中。故事探讨人类与暗夜生物共有的东西——求生的欲望。

扮演热爱一切超自然事物的人类诺埃，冒险走进绝路街上的奇怪房屋，希望那些关于住户的传闻确有其事。在那里，他们遇见了劳雷尔、伊利亚斯与瓦莱里娅，并很快发现，自己已无路可逃。不过，并非每一种结局，都以死亡收场。

[编译自[url=https://www.firstbitegames.com/about]官方网站[/url]]
